en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town surrounded by trees and fields. In the foreground is a landscaped park or garden with paths, lawns, shrubs, and several very tall flagpoles. In the middle distance stand low houses with pitched roofs, and in the center background a church tower with a clock and spire rises above the town. The word "Radeburg." is printed in red in the upper left corner.
